answer: The best IRB CZ pair on garnet is QB12-QB11 with fidelity 0.99869 (uncertainty 0.00035). This comes from default calibration set f81c45da-6e73-4b5d-a0fe-72c75635fade. The runner-up is QB12-QB7 at 0.99802. I ran a Bell circuit (prx on QB12 and QB11, CZ on QB12-QB11, prx on QB11, then measure both qubits) on garnet:mock with 100 shots, as job 01a15fa1-e84d-763f-94d8-5dbb6785b141. Counts were 00:27, 01:18, 10:21, 11:34. The mock returns random-looking results, so these counts do not show a real Bell correlation. Scratch files are in the worktree under scratch/.
